name: pressprimer-certificate
description: Design, issue, and verify certificates on your own site. Drag-and-drop designer, credential IDs, QR verification, and LMS-agnostic issuance.

scripts.build:fonts: PHP=$(ls -d /Applications/Local.app/Contents/Resources/extraResources/lightning-services/php-8.*/bin/darwin-arm64/bin/php 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1); PHP="${PHP:-$(command -v php)}" && "$PHP" scripts/build-fonts.php
scripts.plugin-zip: PHP=$(ls -d /Applications/Local.app/Contents/Resources/extraResources/lightning-services/php-8.*/bin/darwin-arm64/bin/php 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1); PHP="${PHP:-$(command -v php)}" && wp-scripts build && "$PHP" composer.phar install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/pressprimer-certificate && rsync -a --exclude-from='.distignore' ./ dist/pressprimer-certificate/ && (cd dist && zip -rq pressprimer-certificate.zip pressprimer-certificate && rm -rf pressprimer-certificate) && "$PHP" composer.phar install && echo 'Created dist/pressprimer-certificate.zip'
scripts.pot: PHP=$(ls -d /Applications/Local.app/Contents/Resources/extraResources/lightning-services/php-8.*/bin/darwin-arm64/bin/php 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1); PHP="${PHP:-$(command -v php)}"; WPCLI="/Applications/Local.app/Contents/Resources/extraResources/bin/wp-cli/wp-cli.phar"; [ -f "$WPCLI" ] && WP="$PHP $WPCLI" || WP="$(command -v wp)"; $WP i18n make-pot . languages/pressprimer-certificate.pot --domain=pressprimer-certificate --exclude=vendor,node_modules,dist,tests,build,fonts,scripts,docs
